quests.title: Search Chronicle: Cold, Round Belly!

dialogue.t: Ah, it's you two! I've been waiting for ages!
Agh, don't even talk about it. You "negotiated" a period of calm... a very, very brief one.
The moment it recovered, it started trying to bump me off again! ... You know what? You were right. It's not possible to make friends with this creature.
Still, its fruit does taste pretty good — like Pyro, in fact. Reckon my Natlan friends will like it!
What does that even taste like...?
Wanna give it a try? If you want, I could...
E—Err, yeah, no, it's fine! Anyway, are you gonna move on to a Primo Geovishap next?
That's right. I think this one's a winner, to be honest. Primo Geovishaps are quite like the Tepetlisauri, after all.
If you travel to Natlan from Sumeru like I did, I reckon they'll be one of the first things you'll meet.
Sure, whatever you say. Paimon doesn't have high hopes for this one either, though... Why couldn't you have gone with the Hatchlings?
Geovishap Hatchlings don't have round tummies. I imagine it's all that incredibly quick rolling they do. That can't leave you much of a chance to store up fat...
*sigh* But the main reason's still the lack of... impact. What's a Hatchling to those friends of mine who live alongside Saurians?
But a Primo Geovishap, now that's a different story. Even as a tale, it'll be worth the time of day. And anyway, a strong protagonist's gotta have strong opponents, you dig?
Alright. Let's not tarry, shall we? The Primo Geovishap awaits!

dialogue.sit: I've got other things to handle. See you in a bit.

quests.description: After the Pyro Regisvine, Ranjit’s next target is a Primo Geovishap…
